text: I am a San Clemente resident, born and raised, and a history teacher at San Clemente High School. I now have the privilege of raising my own family in this slice of heaven. In 2022, I was elected to the San Clemente City Council. It has been my honor to serve the citizens of this great city. While in office, I have worked to bring more sand to our beaches, increase our trolley lines, reduce homelessness, and create safer roads for our e-bike community. I have also worked with partners to expand recreational amenities, such as new pickleball courts, a pump track, a minigolf course, and a goat grazing program.

Going forward, I will make sure that San Clemente stays focused on local issues. This includes fire safety and mitigation, continuing sand nourishment and retention, supporting our small businesses and non-profits, keeping our kids safe on our streets, reducing our carbon footprint, and protecting our community from pesticides, landfill expansion, and battery farms. I believe that our city is at its best when we focus on what brings us together as a community in order to enhance our quality of life in this amazing place we call home.

text: Please consider voting for Steve Knoblock for San Clemente City Council, District 2.
My commitment has always been to protect San Clemente's exceptional quality of life while ensuring our police officers and firefighters have the resources they need to keep our community safe.
I helped secure 250,000 cubic yards of sand at the Pier and another 40,000 cubic yards at North Beach to protect and restore our beaches.

To reduce wildfire risk, I championed a pilot program using goats instead of toxic herbicides or expensive mechanical equipment to clear fire-fuel vegetation in our open-space canyons. The program's success has led to its expansion into HOA canyons and other City properties.

When Chilean burglary crews targeted our neighborhoods and illegal panga boats used our beaches for criminal activity, I worked with U.S. Customs and Border Protection to help bring ocean-facing cameras to City property in support of law enforcement.
I also support creating a small dog-friendly beach south of T Street, giving San Clemente's thousands of dog owners a place to enjoy the coast with their pets.
I would be honored to earn your vote.

Steve Knoblock
San Clemente City Council, District 2
